The abstract says 'humanized mice' without naming the strain or HBV-infection status; placed on the human-liver-chimeric track because a human-hepatocyte liver is what detects human-transcriptome seed off-targets. Comparator ALN-HBV is elebsiran's non-member parent.
safety.reason: Humanized-mouse ALT margin held in volunteers
safety.note: Humanized mice showed markedly lower ALT with VIR-2218 than ALN-HBV; healthy volunteers had ALT elevations on ALN-HBV (28%) and none on VIR-2218.
safety.short: Mouse ALT margin held in volunteers
safety.quote: In humanized mice, alanine aminotransferase (ALT) levels were markedly lower following administration of VIR-2218 compared with ALN-HBV. In healthy volunteers, post-treatment ALT elevations occurred in 28% of participants receiving ALN-HBV compared with none in those receiving VIR-2218.
safety.judgement: The model stated a hepatic-safety prediction for a member (ESC+ elebsiran spares ALT where its parent did not) and the volunteer data agreed in direction; the species could show ALT, so the comparison is admissible and the source states it. Later patient ALT elevations are immune flares an immunodeficient model cannot show, so they are not a miss on this track.
